name: Ton Diepeveen - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the United Nations Convention on the International Effects of Judicial Sales of Ships
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should join a United Nations agreement on ships sold by court order. Under this agreement, a court-ordered ship sale in one country would be recognised in other countries that join. The buyer would get the ship free of old debts and claims. The Parliament's legal affairs committee supports this, but its report also raises concerns about national control, creditors' rights and weaker standards.

- **What changes:** Court-ordered ship sales in one country would be recognised in other countries that join the agreement.
- **Who it affects:** Ship buyers, creditors, seafarers, national registries and tax and environmental authorities.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament has given its consent, so the Council can now conclude the agreement for the EU.
